apply_to_tensors: recursively apply a function to all PyTorch tensors nested in dicts, lists, tuples, or sets
apply_to_type: recursively apply a function to all objects matching a type predicate across nested container types
to_np: convert a PyTorch tensor or nested container of tensors to NumPy arrays
from_np: convert a NumPy array or nested container of arrays to PyTorch tensors
pack_kwargs: flatten positional and keyword arguments into separate key and value tuples for later reconstruction
